idea-plugin.name: SmartLens
idea-plugin.description:
SmartLens helps developers who work with AI agents to understand, verify and learn from the code those agents produce. It tells which uncommitted changes were made by an AI agent, by you, or by both, and combines this with your Git history.
  • Overview: a dashboard with headline numbers, pending changes by origin, the new skills agents used most, and a hotspot map (churn vs. share written by AI, bubble size = risk).
  • Learn: skills (APIs, language features, annotations) used by AI agents that never appear in your own commits.
  • Understand: pending changes attributed to an AI agent, to you, or to both, ranked by review priority, with the diff one double-click away.
  • Risk: hotspots that changed often, were largely written by AI and that you know little about.
Open it from Tools | SmartLens; settings are in Settings | Tools | SmartLens.

Works with any AI agent that edits files on disk (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Aider) and with Co-authored-by commit trailers. An optional agent hook log makes attribution precise. Requires a Git repository. Everything runs locally: SmartLens makes no network calls and collects no data.
